home.valueProp: Jaipur blue pottery and brass gift décor for shops, importers, and hospitality buyers. We quote in writing before production starts.
bullets: Two product lines you can order now: pottery and brass
Samples available before you commit to bulk
English invoices and one contact from quote to shipment
Decorative pottery labelled not for food unless you request otherwise

faq.a: We are an export company that works with Jaipur workshops. You deal with one team for pricing, packing, and shipping papers.
Our standard range is for display and gift use, not for serving food. Tell us if you need food contact items and we will quote separately.
Most bulk orders leave from Mundra port in Gujarat. We state the shipping term clearly on your quote. We can include sea freight to your port when you ask.
We send samples by courier with an invoice for customs. You sign off colours and finish before we run bulk.

faq.q: Who handles EU or UK product rules?
faq.a: You import into your country. We give you product details and any test reports we have so your compliance team can approve the line.
Yes, if we agree it on the order. We send production photos during the run in any case.

importers.title: How to order
importers.lead: From first email to goods on the water.

steps.title: Send your brief
steps.body: What you want to buy, rough quantity, destination country, and how you plan to sell it.

steps.title: Approve samples
steps.body: We ship samples. You confirm the look and quality in writing.

steps.title: Confirm the order
steps.body: You receive price, quantity, lead time, packing plan, and payment steps in one quote.

steps.title: Receive shipping papers
steps.body: Invoice, packing list, and bill of lading for your freight forwarder or broker.

steps.title: After delivery
steps.body: Tell us about transit damage with photos within the agreed time. Share reorder plans when you have them.
